# Miauterm 0.1.4-coral

Small fixes for Debian reset and language handling.

- Make Reset Debian replace the current root filesystem with the bundled clean Debian image, and reset the selected Linux user and hostname.
- Remove the incomplete language picker and ship English strings only.

This release keeps the Coral codename and includes signed ARM64 APKs with SHA-256 checksums. Install on Android 7.0 or newer with an ARM64 processor.
